summary: Configured node1 to display “Authorized access only” before local console and SSH logins. Verified both paths before and after a successful node reboot.
actions_performed: Set `/etc/issue` and `/etc/issue.net` to the required banner
Configured sshd to use `/etc/issue.net` and validated its syntax
Reloaded sshd and verified the live SSH and tty1 pre-login displays
Rebooted node1 exactly once and verified boot identity changed and all required behavior recovered

evidence.summary: The live tty1 screen showed “Authorized access only” before `node1 login:` both before and after reboot.
Direct unauthenticated SSH probes to node1’s managed IP displayed the required banner before authentication, including after reboot.
Both issue files contain the exact text, sshd syntax is valid, the effective Banner is `/etc/issue.net`, and sshd remains active and enabled.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID `1a816f1f-858b-4487-af28-54070d4ce684`, received reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID `6330ebf6-4485-4680-990a-66ed38580936`, then confirmed running system state, active services, intact configuration, and recovered local and SSH banners.
